item.title: Overgrown foliage forcing pedestrians and pushchairs towards the road, 28th September
item.description:
There is significant overgrown foliage at the bottom of Camdale Road which is encroaching across the public pavement and substantially reducing the usable width of the footpath. As the attached photographs demonstrate, pedestrians — including parents pushing prams — are being forced right towards the kerb and road in order to get around the vegetation. This is a pedestrian safety issue, not simply a cosmetic problem. The pavement needs to remain safely accessible for parents with pushchairs, young children, wheelchair users and people with limited mobility. Please arrange for the foliage to be properly cut back to the boundary/fence line so that the full usable width of the public pavement is restored. Please also ensure that the report is not marked as resolved until the obstruction has actually been cleared. This appears to be another example locally of vegetation being allowed to substantially encroach onto a public footway before action is taken. Please consider whether more regular inspection and preventative maintenance is required.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Camdale Road, Plumstead
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Removed Street Lamp on Kent House Lane – Photo and Video Evidence Available, 28th September
item.description:
28 September 2026 Dear Bromley Council, RE: Removed Street Lamp on Kent House Lane – Photo and Video Evidence Available I am writing regarding a street lamp column on Kent House Lane, near our home and opposite Made Up, which has recently been removed. The lamp post had previously been damaged several times by large vehicles connected with Made Up. On the most recent occasion, the damage occurred between approximately 11:38am and 11:45am on 21 September 2026. I have photo and video evidence showing the lorry damaging the lamp post, including evidence from the time of the incident. Please find the relevant files attached for your investigation. We are concerned that the lamp column has now been removed but has not been replaced. This has left this part of Kent House Lane much darker and may create a safety issue for residents, pedestrians and road users, particularly at night. Could you please investigate this matter and confirm: 1. Whether the lamp column is going to be replaced. 2. When the replacement is expected to take place. 3. Whether the Council will investigate the repeated damage caused by the lorry. 4. Whether any action can be taken to prevent the same problem happening again, such as repositioning or protecting the new lamp column. 5. Whether any further evidence or information is required from us. As the lamp post has been damaged more than once, we are concerned that simply replacing it in the same position without addressing the cause may result in further damage. We would be grateful if the Council could review the attached evidence and advise what action will now be taken. Many thanks. We look forward to hearing from you. Kind regards, Mrs Vu & Mr Doan 87 Kent House Lane BR3 1LE

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Kent House Lane, New Beckenham, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
